name: FREELANDER, Dr Michael (Mike) Randolph

headline.note: Freelander's public-hospital and private-practice paediatric work overlapped for decades, but available sources do not establish hours, FTE allocation or precise practice boundaries. Medical and leadership titles do not prove full-time status. Voluntary post-election clinics and elected office are excluded; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: University of Sydney alumni record establishes MBBS graduation in 1978. Enrolment date, study load and work overlap remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Royal North Shore Hospital / NSW public health system
career_spells.evidence_note: Own biography and GP Link introduction identify a residency at Royal North Shore before paediatric training at Royal Alexandra. Dates, appointment terms, hours and leave are unknown; 1978 graduation is not copied as the job start.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.employer: Royal Alexandra Hospital for Children, Camperdown
career_spells.role: Paediatric training and early paediatric practice
career_spells.evidence_note: Royal Alexandra paediatric training followed Royal North Shore residency and preceded Campbelltown work from 1984, according to own biography and GP Link. Frozen occupation says paediatrician from 1978, which is also the university graduation year; it does not establish continuous Royal Alexandra employment during 1978–1984. Former contextual boundaries are retained here only as context, not employment dates. Exact appointments, hours, leave and transitions unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Public medical employment is supported, but the inferred outer bounds and unknown full-time status do not support an exact total.

career_spells.employer: Campbelltown Hospital / NSW public health system
career_spells.role: Paediatrician; Head of Paediatrics (start year disputed: 1986 or 1990; ended 2013)
career_spells.evidence_note: The party biography gives a 1984 paediatric residency start; secondary material records Head of Paediatrics from 1986 to 2013 and resignation from the public position for constitutional eligibility before the 2016 election. Exact appointment/resignation dates, payroll entity, hours, FTE allocation and leave are unresolved. Own biography and GP Link give head role 1986–2013, whereas current ALP biography says it began in 1990. Hospital appointment records are needed to resolve this. ABC 2017 corroborates pre-election job relinquishment but supplies no exact cessation date. NHMRC member biography also says1986–2013 for head role; employer appointment documentation still needed to resolve1990 alternative.
career_spells.counting_note: Public hospital employment is supported, but substantive full-time status and exact boundaries are not established.

career_spells.employer: Freelander paediatric practices in Campbelltown and Camden; Pebema P/L identified as medical-practice company (earlier entities unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: Campbelltown City Council says he moved to the region as a locum in the early1980s and grew paediatric practices in Campbelltown and Camden; the secondary biography places establishment in1984. Legal entities, opening/closing dates, hours, staff, ownership and allocation against public-hospital work are unresolved. Election is not treated as exact cessation: a public transcription of the45th Parliament interests return records Pebema P/L medical-practice-company income on27September2016, after the2July election. This proves an income observation, not personal clinical work or its duration. The2025 primary interests statement identifies his directorship in Pebema and describes it as a defunct medical-practice company, now a superannuation trustee; the2019 transcription already uses that description. These observations identify a practice entity and later ceased-operation condition, not incorporation, full operating interval or exact clinical cessation. No assumption that Pebema operated throughout the1984-onwards career; end remains null because exact closure is unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Private self-employment is supported, but hours, precise dates and overlap prevent an exact full-time total.

career_spells.employer: University of Western Sydney (now Western Sydney University)
career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography records lecturing at the university during his medical career. Appointment dates, title, payroll, remuneration, hours and overlaps are unresolved. Own biography and 2021 GP Link introduction corroborate lecturing, without appointment boundaries or paid/honorary status.
career_spells.counting_note: University employment is excluded from the narrow public/private headline under the current codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Secondary material cites his public statement that he continued regular voluntary clinics after entering Parliament in 2016. Frequency, exact dates and any reimbursements are unresolved; the work is expressly described as voluntary. First-person GP Link interview independently establishes ongoing Campbelltown clinical activity in November 2021, but does not itself state remuneration or frequency; unpaid classification still rests on the earlier explicit voluntary-clinic account. November2019 own newsletter provides direct first-person corroboration of former employee/current volunteer status at Campbelltown Hospital. It does not give personal hours or exact conversion date.
career_spells.counting_note: Unpaid work is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current biographies establish House service from 2 July 2016. Committee duties are nested within elected service.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: National COVID-19 Health and Research Advisory Committee
career_spells.evidence_note: NCHRAC report dated 12 May 2021 identifies him as working-group chair. GP Link interview confirms committee participation in November 2021. Governance/advisory activity, not evidence of a separate full-time clinical job. Appointment dates, hours and remuneration unresolved. NHMRC institutional history gives committee operation April2020–31March2022, providing outer limits only; his own appointment/cessation dates are not stated.
career_spells.counting_note: Advisory/governance participation excluded; report date is not an appointment boundary.

career_spells.role: Director; former medical-practice company and superannuation trustee
career_spells.evidence_note: Self directorship recorded in19August2025 primary interests statement, also in2019 secondary transcription. Appointment date and remuneration unknown. Governance and fund management are distinct from clinical practice; dates of disclosures are not employment boundaries.
career_spells.counting_note: Company governance and investment interests excluded; no additional full-time operational employment inferred.

research_notes: The official occupation line collapses a multi-employer medical career into 'paediatrician from 1978'; hospital, private-practice, teaching and volunteer work are separated here.
Public-hospital and private-practice work overlapped, so neither can be treated as a continuous exclusive full-time interval without roster or practice evidence.
The 2016 election is not silently substituted for an exact private-practice endpoint.
Regular clinics after election are recorded as unpaid because the available statement expressly describes them as voluntary.

Follow-up 2026-10-01: primary university graduation evidence and previously omitted Royal North Shore residency clarify the pre-1984 sequence. Removed inferred Royal Alexandra employment boundaries and the unsourced private-practice election endpoint while retaining the earlier contextual evidence.

Attempted avenues: official member/party biographies, university alumni database, GP Link interview, RACP podcast, NSW Health service directories and annual-report searches, business-register searches and full-time/part-time/resignation queries. No named private-practice entity, employment FTE or leave/cessation schedule established. NSW Health clinic page timed out; indexed service listing corroborates clinical presence only. HealthShare profile did not expose usable biography on open; university record supplied qualification evidence instead.

Further leads: Royal North Shore/Royal Alexandra personnel or annual reports; Campbelltown head appointment evidence resolving 1986 versus 1990; private-practice legal entities and closure evidence; WSU appointment classification. Contemporary report describing post-election clinics as part time does not establish payment or pre-election FTE. Governance and teaching remain separate from clinical employment.

Second follow-up2October2026 identifies Pebema as a former medical-practice company using the primary2025 disclosure and2019 transcription. Practice closure is evidenced as an existing condition, not assigned to election day or disclosure date. Directorship is separate from operational work.

Targeted visiting-medical-officer, full-time, resignation and legal-entity searches did not establish clinical hours or a personnel resignation day. A2019 first-person newsletter independently confirms volunteer status. Original45P disclosure link was restricted in web reader; current public48P PDF downloaded successfully when the reader itself could not open it. ABR view failed; commercial registry search was not used to infer employment. Next priority: original2016–19 practice accounts/closure record, hospital employment appointment terms and early residency dates.

Follow-up3October2026: targeted Royal North Shore residency,1979, head-of-paediatrics1986, NSW Health1984 and Pebema cessation searches returned the already known residency sequence,1986 versus1990 conflict and practice-declaration lead. NHMRC and GP Link corroborate1986; ALP biography still gives1990. Repetition does not resolve the conflict or show individual hours. No new substantive employment fact added. Do not rerun these generic queries absent a personnel/annual-report or closure-document lead; current unresolved priorities unchanged.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 found a public transcription of the45th Parliament interests return recording Pebema P/L medical-practice-company income on27September2016. This materially confirms that election did not itself prove all private-practice income had ended, while not establishing post-election clinical work, hours, the income period or closure. Targeted original hospital/personnel and Pebema searches otherwise repeated the1986/1990 conflict and later defunct-company disclosures. Preserve the null practice endpoint and seek the original return or accounts before assigning a cessation date.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Inspected full public RACP2022 transcript and recovered member-hosted inaugural speech14September2016 after APH reader Internal Error. Both corroborate known clinical/training sequence; rounded36/37-year statements are not appointment dates or FT evidence. Hospital clinical directory is accessible but retains pre2022 development wording, so retrieval date does not prove current personal activity. Service opening hours are not his roster. No net hours, personnel instrument, Pebema closure or new employer established. These particular transcripts/directories are now exhausted pending original payroll, clinic records or dated practice accounts.
open_questions: What were the exact Children's Hospital training appointments, dates, hours and leave from 1978 to 1984?
What were the Campbelltown Hospital payroll entity, appointment dates, hours/FTE and resignation date, including the Head of Paediatrics term?
What were the legal entities, dates, ownership and weekly hours of the Campbelltown and Camden private practices?
How were hours allocated between public hospital, private practice and university teaching?
What were the Western Sydney University appointment dates, remuneration and teaching load?
Did any paid private medical work continue after election, separately from the documented voluntary clinics?
What were the Royal North Shore residency dates and its transition to Royal Alexandra training?
Did Campbelltown departmental leadership begin in 1986 or 1990, and why do the primary biographies differ?

When did Pebema P/L operate the clinical practice and cease that activity, which earlier entities preceded it, and what dates/hours applied to Freelander’s paid clinical work separately from later fund trusteeship?
